title: Stress IQ test during Air Force recruitment screening

tellings.quote: And so you take the same test, but I put on this oxygen mask that sealed my face with no air coming to it.

plain: A former military helicopter pilot named Jake Barber says that in 1994, during screening to join the Air Force near UCLA in California, he took an intelligence test twice: once normally, and once wearing an oxygen mask sealed over his face with no air coming in. Barber tells this from his own experience, as an example of how recruits were tested for thinking under stress.
